metadata.description: Senior-specialist skills for the hard, production-critical parts of software engineering: backend reliability, adversarial review, and frontend craft.

plugins.name: the-hard-parts
plugins.description: Eight senior-specialist skills for the hard parts of backend systems: API response normalization, cold-start optimization, event pipelines, idempotency, rate limiting, resilience, caching strategy, and auth flows. Each produces an HTML/Markdown design document plus real implementation artifacts (code, DDL, IaC, tests). Ships per-skill slash commands and a /hard-parts discovery command.

plugins.name: review-toolkit
plugins.description: Adversarial, persona-driven review skills. Ships blind-spot-breaker (four hostile personas, including an on-call/operability persona) with a /adversarial-review command.

plugins.name: frontend-hard-parts
plugins.description: Senior-specialist frontend skills: expressive-motion-architect (bold spring-physics/shape-morph/motion design across Compose, Flutter, and web) and ux-reviewer (adversarial, persona-driven usability review). Ships /expressive-motion, /ux-review, and a /frontend-hard-parts discovery command.
